mcopt.options.render_scale.tooltip: Renders the world at a lower resolution and rebuilds full resolution with MetalFX temporal upscaling. Lower is faster. Turns Frame Generation off while on.
mcopt.options.frame_generation.tooltip: Generates a frame between every two rendered frames with MetalFX frame interpolation, shown on the display's refresh. Paced keeps the same pacing without generated frames. Not available together with Render Scale.
